taskDescription: Locate the anchor function for the event_token field in the console.log object whose action is analytics.track after typing the event name, choosing the source and platform, granting consent, and clicking Send Event on the page. The same event_token value is also sent inside the body of a navigator.sendBeacon request to the collect endpoint issued on track. The anchor function is the first target-specific request-transform value constructor on the dynamic behavior chain: after delegated click routing, action routing, the track gate, event-property collection with page-context snapshot, tuple input preparation, asynchronous scheduling and runtime config selection, its function body itself constructs the target observable analytics event token rather than merely collecting inputs, dispatching control, wrapping a return value, or writing the value to the console or sendBeacon call. Return exactly one complete function as a single JSON object (see answer_format). Do not return generic utilities, event handlers, the full call chain, the final console sink, or the sendBeacon call site. Note: you may only inspect code under captures; the full codebase is not accessible.

Anchor (Pattern A2 Envelope)；target-specific；函数体组合分支选择、路由异或、mask、runtimeTicket 决策，并直接 return k + encodeEventToken(reducers[j](...))；return 形态为 'an_' + 16 个字符，与参考示例 an_a1b2c3d4e5000000 结构完全一致（^an_[a-z0-9]{16}$）；其调用者 u/d 仅做通用配置转发，本函数是最浅层专门实现目标事件 token 构造的入口；encodeEventToken 是其内部嵌套子步骤，本函数自身返回最终目标 observable，因此为 anchor。
